blocks.tamil_translation: said: “Since I embraced Islam, whatever word I spoke, I have always spoken only after thinking. (But today forgetfulness has occurred.) Forget that. From now on, remember what I tell you. I have heard Rasulullah ﷺ say, “When people make gold and silver their treasure, you make these words your treasure” (اَللّهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْئَلُكَ الثَّبَاتَ فِي اْلاَمْرِ، وَالْعَزِيْمَةَ عَلَي الرُّشْدِ، وَاَسْئَلُكَ شُكْرَ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَاَسْئَلُكَ حُسْنَ عِبَادَتِكَ، وَاَسْئَلُكَ قَلْبًا سَلِيْمًا، وَاَسْئَلُكَ لِسَاناً صَادِقًا، وَاَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَاَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا تَعْلَمُ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوْبِ) “O Allah! I ask You for steadfastness in all matters and firmness upon right guidance. I also ask You for the opportunity to be grateful for the blessings You have given. I also ask for the opportunity to worship You in a beautiful way. I ask You for a heart that is pure (from shirk and kufr). I ask You for a tongue that speaks the truth. I ask You for all the good that You know. I ask for protection from all the evils that You know. I ask You to forgive all those of my sins, however many of them You know. Surely You are the One who knows best all hidden things”.
